changes: The week's main movement is defensive, not offensive: Simbian's independent benchmark shows Claude Haiku 5.5 regressing on cyber defense versus Haiku 4.5 (9.3% vs 17.6% coverage), while OpenAI formally designated the October GPT-6 Sol and Luna snapshots as High capability in Cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework. New reporting also attributes Claude agents, alongside the ARTEX AI pentest suite, to the South Korean bank intrusions already on the ledger; separately, Anthropic's four-case eval postmortem and UK AISI's eval-hardening blog now have primary sources (anthropic coverage and aisi.gov.uk) even though both remain on the rejected list and are not re-reported here.
